extracted.intended_audience: secondary English teachers and community college instructors (grades 11-12) using Turnitin/GradeMark
extracted.subtask_description: Common Core–aligned analytic rubrics for evaluating Grades 11–12 student writing in three modes (argument, informative, narrative), intended to guide instruction, assessment, and feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Argument — Claim
rubrics_metrics.description: The text introduces a clear, arguable claim that can be supported by reasons and evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text introduces a compelling claim that is clearly arguable and takes a purposeful position on an issue. The text has a structure and organization that is carefully crafted to support the claim.
4 Skilled: The text introduces a precise claim that is clearly arguable and takes a position. The text has an effective structure and organization to support the position.
3 Proficient: The text introduces a claim that is arguable and takes a position. The text has a structure and organization that is aligned with the claim.
2 Developing: The text contains an unclear or emerging claim that suggests a vague position. The text attempts a structure and organization to support the position.
1 Inadequate: The text contains an unidentifiable claim or vague position. The text has a limited structure and organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Argument — Development
rubrics_metrics.description: The text provides sufficient data and evidence to back up the claim while pointing out the strengths and limitations of both the claim and counterclaim. The text provides a conclusion that supports the argument.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text provides convincing and relevant data and evidence to back up the claim and skillfully addresses counterclaims. The conclusion ties to the claim and evidence.
4 Skilled: The text provides sufficient and relevant data and evidence to back up the claim and effectively links counterclaims to the claim. The conclusion effectively strengthens the claim and evidence.
3 Proficient: The text provides data and evidence to back up the claim and addresses counterclaims. The conclusion effectively reinforces the claim and evidence.
2 Developing: The text provides data and evidence that attempt to back up the claim and fairly addresses counterclaims. The conclusion merely restates the position.
1 Inadequate: The text contains limited data and evidence related to the claim and lacks counterclaims. The text may fail to conclude the argument or position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Argument — Audience
rubrics_metrics.description: The text anticipates the audience’s knowledge level, concerns, values, and possible biases about the claim. The text addresses the specific needs of the audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text consistently addresses the audience’s knowledge level, concerns, values, and possible biases about the claim. The text addresses the specific needs of the audience.
4 Skilled: The text anticipates the audience’s knowledge level, concerns, values, and possible biases about the claim. The text addresses the specific needs of the audience.
3 Proficient: The text considers the audience’s knowledge level, concerns, values, and possible biases about the claim and addresses the needs of the audience.
2 Developing: The text illustrates an inconsistent awareness of the audience’s knowledge level and needs.
1 Inadequate: The text lacks an awareness of the audience’s knowledge level and needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Argument — Cohesion
rubrics_metrics.description: The text uses words, phrases, and clauses as well as varied syntax to link the major sections of the text, creates cohesion and clarifies the relationship between the claim and reasons, between reasons and evidence, and between claims and counterclaims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text strategically uses words, phrases, and clauses as well as varied syntax to link the major sections of the text. The text connects the claim and reasons and effectively links the counterclaims to the claim.
4 Skilled: The text skillfully uses words, phrases, and clauses as well as varied syntax to link the major sections of the text. The text attempts to connect the claim and reasons.
3 Proficient: The text uses words, phrases, and clauses as well as varied syntax to link the major sections of the text. The text links the claim and reasons as well as the evidence.
2 Developing: The text contains limited words, phrases, and clauses to link the major sections of the text. The text does not connect the claims and reasons.
1 Inadequate: The text contains few, if any, words, phrases, and clauses to link the major sections of the text and fails to connect the topic and evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Argument — Style and Conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: The text presents a formal, objective tone that demonstrates standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while attending to the norms of the discipline (i.e., MLA, APA, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text presents a formal and objective tone. The text intentionally uses standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while attending to the norms of the discipline.
4 Skilled: The text presents an engaging, formal and objective tone. The text demonstrates standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while attending to the norms of the discipline.
3 Proficient: The text presents a formal tone and demonstrates standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while attending to the norms of the discipline.
2 Developing: The text illustrates a limited awareness of formal tone and some accuracy in standard English conventions of usage and mechanics.
1 Inadequate: The text demonstrates inaccuracy in standard English conventions of usage and mechanics and a limited or inconsistent tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informative — Focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The text focuses on a topic to inform a reader with ideas, concepts, and information that creates a unified whole.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text focuses on a compelling topic that informs the reader with ideas, concepts, and information that creates a unified whole.
4 Skilled: The text clearly focuses on a topic that informs the reader with ideas, concepts, and information that creates a unified whole.
3 Proficient: The text focuses on an interesting topic that informs the reader with ideas, concepts, and information.
2 Developing: The text has a topic that informs the reader with some ideas, concepts, and information.
1 Inadequate: The text has an unidentifiable topic with minimal ideas, concepts, and information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informative — Development
rubrics_metrics.description: The text presents facts, extended definitions, concrete details, quotations, and examples. The text provides a conclusion that supports the topic and examines its implications and significance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text provides significant and relevant facts, extended definitions, concrete details, quotations, and/or examples that thoroughly develop and explain the topic. The text provides an engaging conclusion that supports the topic and examines its implications and significance.
4 Skilled: The text provides relevant facts, extended definitions, concrete details, quotations, and/or examples that sufficiently develop and explain the topic. The text provides a conclusion that supports the topic and examines its implications and significance.
3 Proficient: The text provides facts, extended definitions, concrete details, quotations, and/or examples that attempt to develop and explain the topic. The text provides a competent conclusion that supports the topic.
2 Developing: The text provides facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, and/or examples that attempt to develop the topic but may not fully explain it. The text may or may not provide a conclusion.
1 Inadequate: The text contains limited facts and details related to the topic and may lack a conclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informative — Audience
rubrics_metrics.description: The text anticipates the audience’s background knowledge of the topic. The text includes formatting, graphics, and/or multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text consistently addresses the audience’s knowledge level and concerns about the topic and includes appropriate formatting, graphics, and/or multimedia that strengthen comprehension.
4 Skilled: The text anticipates the audience’s knowledge level and concerns about the topic and includes appropriate formatting, graphics, and/or multimedia that enhance comprehension.
3 Proficient: The text considers the audience’s knowledge level and concerns about the topic and includes formatting, graphics, and/or multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
2 Developing: The text illustrates an inconsistent awareness of the audience’s knowledge level about the topic and includes some formatting, graphics, and/or multimedia that may be distracting or irrelevant.
1 Inadequate: The text lacks awareness of the audience’s knowledge level about the topic and includes limited or inaccurate formatting, graphics, and/or multimedia that impedes comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informative — Cohesion
rubrics_metrics.description: The text explains the relationship between ideas and concepts and uses appropriate and varied transitions and syntax to link major sections and connect the topic and examples/facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text strategically uses words, phrases, and clauses to link the major sections of the text and explains the relationships between the topic and the examples and/or facts.
4 Skilled: The text skillfully uses words, phrases, and clauses to link the major sections of the text and identifies the relationship between the topic and examples and/or facts.
3 Proficient: The text uses words, phrases, and clauses to link the major sections of the text and connects the topic and the examples and/or facts.
2 Developing: The text contains limited words, phrases, and clauses to link the major sections and attempts to connect the topic and the examples and/or facts.
1 Inadequate: The text contains few, if any, linking words and does not connect the topic and the examples and/or facts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informative — Language and Style
rubrics_metrics.description: The text presents a formal style and objective tone and uses language, vocabulary, and techniques such as metaphor, simile, and analogy to manage the topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text uses sophisticated language, vocabulary, and techniques such as metaphor, simile, and analogy to manage the complexity of the topic.
4 Skilled: The text presents an engaging, formal, and objective tone and uses precise language and vocabulary and techniques such as metaphor, simile, and analogy to manage the complexity of the topic.
3 Proficient: The text presents a formal, objective tone and uses relevant language, vocabulary, and techniques such as metaphor, simile, and analogy to manage the complexity of the topic.
2 Developing: The text illustrates a limited awareness of formal tone and attempts to use language, vocabulary, and some techniques.
1 Inadequate: The text contains imprecise language, vocabulary, and limited techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informative — Conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: The text demonstrates standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while attending to the norms of the discipline in which they are writing (MLA, APA, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text intentionally uses standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while specifically attending to the norms of the discipline in which they are writing.
4 Skilled: The text demonstrates standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while suitably attending to the norms of the discipline in which they are writing.
3 Proficient: The text demonstrates standard English conventions of usage and mechanics while attending to the norms of the discipline in which they are writing.
2 Developing: The text demonstrates some accuracy in standard English conventions of usage and mechanics.
1 Inadequate: The text contains multiple inaccuracies in standard English conventions of usage and mechanics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative — Exposition
rubrics_metrics.description: The text sets up a story by introducing the event/conflict, characters, and setting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text creatively engages the reader by setting out a well-developed conflict, situation, or observation and its significance. It establishes one or multiple points of view and introduces a narrator and/or well-developed characters.
4 Skilled: The text engages and orients the reader by setting out a conflict, situation, or observation and its significance. It establishes one or multiple points of view and introduces a narrator and/or developed characters.
3 Proficient: The text orients the reader by setting out a conflict, situation, or observation and its significance. It establishes one point of view and introduces a narrator and/or developed characters.
2 Developing: The text provides a setting with a vague conflict, situation, or observation and its significance and introduces an underdeveloped narrator and/or characters.
1 Inadequate: The text provides a setting that is unclear with a vague conflict, situation, or observation and introduces an undeveloped narrator and/or characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative — Narrative Techniques and Development
rubrics_metrics.description: The story is developed using dialogue, pacing, description, reflection, and other narrative techniques—such as showing events and multiple plot lines—to develop experiences, events, and characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text demonstrates sophisticated use of narrative techniques—engaging dialogue, artistic pacing, vivid description, complex reflection, and multiple plot lines—to develop experiences, events, and characters.
4 Skilled: The text demonstrates deliberate use of narrative techniques—dialogue, pacing, description, reflection, and multiple plot lines—to develop experiences, events, and/or characters.
3 Proficient: The text uses narrative techniques, such as dialogue, description, reflection, and multiple plot lines, to showing events and/or experiences.
2 Developing: The text uses some narrative techniques, such as dialogue or description, and merely retells events and/or experiences.
1 Inadequate: The text lacks narrative techniques and merely retells events and/or experiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative — Organization and Cohesion
rubrics_metrics.description: The text follows a logical sequence of events and creates progression using techniques (chronology, flashback, foreshadowing, suspense, etc.) so events build on one another to create a coherent whole.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text creates a seamless progression of experiences or events using multiple techniques (chronology, flashback, foreshadowing, suspense, etc.) that build toward a crafted tone and outcome.
4 Skilled: The text creates a smooth progression of experiences or events using a variety of techniques that build toward a clear tone and outcome.
3 Proficient: The text creates a logical progression of experiences or events using some techniques that build toward a particular tone and outcome.
2 Developing: The text creates a sequence or progression of experiences or events but with limited technique and may lack a clear tone or outcome.
1 Inadequate: The text lacks an identifiable sequence or presents an illogical sequence of events and lacks an identifiable tone and/or outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative — Style and Conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: The text uses sensory language and details to create a vivid picture of the events, setting, and characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text uses eloquent words and phrases, showing details and rich sensory language and mood to convey experiences, events, settings, and/or characters.
4 Skilled: The text uses precise words and phrases, showing details and controlled sensory language and mood to convey a realistic picture of the experiences, events, setting, and/or characters.
3 Proficient: The text uses words and phrases, telling details and sensory language to convey experiences, events, setting, and/or characters.
2 Developing: The text uses words and phrases, telling details to convey experiences, events, setting, and/or characters but with limited control.
1 Inadequate: The text merely tells experiences, lacking sensory detail and vivid language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative — Conclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Conclusion that follows from the course of the narrative and provides a reflection on or resolution of the events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
5 Exceptional: The text moves to a conclusion that artfully follows from and thoughtfully reflects on what is experienced, observed, or resolved over the course of the narrative.
4 Skilled: The text builds to a conclusion that logically follows from and reflects on what is experienced, observed, or resolved over the course of the narrative.
3 Proficient: The text provides a conclusion that follows from and reflects on what is experienced, observed, or resolved over the course of the narrative.
2 Developing: The text provides a conclusion that follows from what is experienced, observed, or resolved over the course of the narrative but may be weak.
1 Inadequate: The text may provide a conclusion that merely restates events or fails to reflect on or resolve the narrative.
